name: Security Guard
text: Hey! Where are you going? Where is your ID?

name: Player
text: Sir, I'm here to take admission in Vidhya Institute of Technology. I'm a new student.

name: Security Guard
text: Oh, you're here for admission? Then do you have your allotment form?

name: Player
text: No, sir. I don't have the allotment form with me.

name: Security Guard
text: Then you can't enter without it. You need the allotment form with college ID, VIT2208.

name: Player
text: Okay, sir. Where can I get the allotment form?

name: Security Guard
text: There's a cyber cafe nearby. Go there and get your allotment form.

name: Player
text: Alright, sir. I'll get it and come back.

name: Security Guard
text: Good. Bring the form here and I'll let you in.
